instruction: Update the font size of the slide's title text to 48 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title font size to 48 points. The evaluator extracts the font size from the title text and compares it to 48 with a tolerance of 2 points to account for LibreOffice rounding.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts title font size from PPTX file and converts EMU to points
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (receives 48 directly, not wrapped in rules dict)
Metric uses tolerance appropriately (2 points) to handle LibreOffice rounding
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement (title font size = 48 points)
Minor issue: Getter uses heuristic approach (first text shape) to find title instead of checking placeholder type, which could fail if slide has non-title text shapes first (rare in practice)
Edge case: If title has multiple runs with different font sizes, only first run is checked
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE to more reliably identify the title shape
Consider verifying all runs in the title have the same font size, or documenting that only the first run is checked
